_doc: Researched WLB (out of 5) and stability (Growing/Stable/Caution) per company, with evidence and date. Method: .claude/skills/refresh-london-ds/wlb_stability.py. Edit by research only; never infer from a posting.

Sony Interactive Entertainment.stability_evidence: SIE had studio cuts 2024-25 but data/analytics weren't targeted; DS reqs actively hiring.

Spotify.wlb_note: The best on the original list.
Spotify.stability_evidence: No company-wide round since Dec 2023; recent cuts small and podcast-only; core R&D rising; London eng/data not hit.

Monzo.stability_evidence: Only ~50 US-exit roles early 2026 (EU-licence refocus); UK revenue over GBP 1bn, profit GBP 60.4m FY25; explicit visa sponsorship.

Ripple.wlb_note: 10+ office days a month; mixed reviews.
Ripple.stability_evidence: Expanding after regulatory clarity; active London hiring.

Stripe.wlb_note: Accept the WLB hit only if level and comp are right; at least 50% office per month.
Stripe.stability_evidence: Zero layoffs in 2026; ~509 open roles; USD 1.9tn payment volume; USD 159bn valuation.

Google.wlb_note: Strong for FAANG; better than Meta's reputation.
Google.stability_evidence: Rolling smaller cuts through 2025-26 for non-AI roles (Cloud UX, Platforms & Devices, manager delayering); Alphabet headcount still up ~4%. London DS posts turn over within days.

QuantumBlack (McKinsey).wlb_note: Worst WLB on the original list; client-facing with travel.
QuantumBlack (McKinsey).stability_evidence: QuantumBlack growing and hiring in London; wider McKinsey contracting (~5,000 cut by mid-2025).

TikTok.wlb_note: Not verified; long-hours reputation - check before applying.
TikTok.stability_evidence: 2025 trust-and-safety cuts (~400 London); commercial and Shop DS expanding; regulatory overhang remains.

Revolut.wlb_note: 9-12 hour days are a recurring review theme - treat as weak despite the score.
Revolut.stability_evidence: No mass layoffs 2022-26; ~12,000 staff; full UK banking licence March 2026; London's share shrinking versus India.

G-Research.stability_evidence: Net-hiring in research; 2023-24 London tech cuts were mostly research engineering; quants spared.

Deliveroo.stability_evidence: Now part of DoorDash; London DS hiring active (4 live roles Oct 2026).

The Trade Desk.stability_evidence: ~15% workforce cut (~575) in Sept 2026 after a weak Q2 and a 67% stock fall.
